# Workspaces

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A core plugin that enables you to create, save, and load workspace layouts.

## Scope note

- Enables customized arrangement of Obsidian notes in different layouts.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
